title: Bizarre mall experience
content: First things first...I recently discovered this sub & was in awe of other's experiences. I am looking for any insight or interpretation (or similar experience) of a bizarre dream I had a couple of months ago. I was in the "middle" of a mall. Pretty water fountain...lots of people. I had the sudden urge to leave my dream, but I couldn't. I tried jerking my body etc. Suddenly, ALL eyes were on me. EVERYONE was pointing and laughing saying stuff along the lines of "hahahaha she can't leave!". It did not feel humorous or fun...it felt scary & wrong. I felt like an outlier and that I did not belong. I remember this dream so vividly because I started banging my head against a wall inside of the mall with the intent to just...get out. I literally felt the pain on my head. That's how desperate I was to get out. I have vivid dreams & typically lucid dream only when I meditate. I did not meditate this time but lawd was I lucid! The feeling I had when I woke up was indescribable. More than a dream. The only time I felt this feeling was waking from another lucid dream...quick story about *that* dream: A scary girl was chasing me and I turned her into my "friend"...she then toured me around a beautiful city. I lay in beautiful green grass & said "wow....I wish I could stay here forever". A woman in black hovered over me & said she could make that possible. I told her I was on this earth for a reason. The dream ended. This is my first time posting. Let me know your thoughts or similar experiences. Thanks :)
